This file exists so the negative check can prove that an unexecuted example
is rejected instead of silently accepted.
The four fault categories are state-read (gksr.status.reminderUnavailable),
corner-hud (gksr.status.hudUnavailable), beacon (gksr.status.beaconUnavailable)
and popup (gksr.status.popupUnavailable); there is no fifth category for a
notifier failure.
Fault notices are titleless, iconless, non-blocking plain-text notifications
with native lifetime and auto-dismiss; they never pause the game or capture
input.
At most one actually displayed notice per category per genuine load; a failed
show logs only and never consumes eligibility; a queued notice is cleared if
the fault recovers before display or the load ends; recovery adds no success
message.
